about: What is settled about this camera's menus and file, generated by kit/tools/coverage.py --write from the public sources alone (the definition, the hand tables, the camera file, the Help Guide's menu list, camkit.safety) and the few facts a look establishes that hold for every camera of the model (an information screen and its field names, a row that acts when opened, a hand check that changed a record, a row of the maker's Save/Load list seen to change nothing): one status per row, per value of each setting and per record, in the order of precedence docs/DATA_CONTRACTS.md gives (docs/decisions/0023). Nothing observed of the camera's state, never a run, a date, a hash, a current option or a value (docs/decisions/0016).
